claimed_violation.value: does not properly check string lengths
claimed_violation.evidence_text: does not properly check string lengths

root_hypothesis.predicate: ndr_pull_charset_to_null() fails to enforce that the length of the string being pulled does not exceed the available buffer size, leading to a potential out-of-bounds read or write.
positive_evidence: The function reads or writes beyond the bounds of the input buffer when the string length is not properly validated.
The function does not check that the string length is within the remaining data length before copying or processing.
The function may cause a buffer overflow or underflow when handling malformed input with unexpected string lengths.
insufficient_evidence: The function returns an error code without any memory safety impact.
The function produces a non-null output but does not access memory outside the intended buffer.
The function is called with a valid string length that is always within bounds.
